title: code_index.module_graph response
description: Every list is sorted, so the same index and arguments always produce the same response.

indexed.description: False when no workspace has been indexed; the lists are then empty because nothing was measured, not because the workspace has no dependencies.

nodes.description: Sorted by id. The workspace root is `.`.

edges.description: Sorted by (from, to). Never contains a self-loop.

weight.description: Distinct import links from files in `from` into `to`. A whole-module import counts once per node the module's files fall in.

sample.description: Smallest (importing file, imported file or module root) pairs.

external.description: Empty unless include_external. Sorted by (from, spec).

spec.description: The import's string literal when it has one, else the statement as written.

unresolved_count.description: Import statements in node files that resolved to no workspace file.

index_seq.description: Change-log sequence the graph was read at.
